source_policy.rule: A readable manufacturer label hosted by a retailer is distinguished from a retailer-authored table. Either may support a candidate when the exact product version, market, pack, serving basis and variant applicability are established under that retailer source context.
source_policy.comparison: Compare a second retailer when available. A missing second source does not block an exact readable table, and copied images or descriptions are not independent confirmation.
source_policy.absence: Omission from an active table is not confirmed absence; inspect ingredients and declarations, then retain no_information if no explicit conclusion is supported.
source_policy.access: Assess each retailer terms and robots rules independently. Catalogue or affiliate presence does not grant blanket copying rights.
